text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewer calls the powertrain contest between the AMG EQE and i5 M60 a tie, although the AMG is quicker on paper (0-100 km/h 3.3 vs 3.7 s). Reviewer states the EQE's adaptive suspension stays supple and gentle, while the i5 transmits more road unevenness even in Comfort mode. Reviewer finds the EQE's steering a little heavy, while the i5 feels lighter and more agile in tight urban spaces. Reviewer rates the EQE's interior better than the i5's, praising its luxurious ambience and finish. Reviewer finds BMW's infotainment system easier to use than MBUX. Reviewer states voice control works very well in both the EQE and the i5. Reviewer prefers the i5's sportier look and finds the EQE's styling too conservative. Reviewer notes the EQE needs 32 minutes for 10-80 % at up to 170 kW, versus 20-30 minutes at up to 205 kW for the i5. Reviewer lists the EQE's on-board space as a strength and says the i5 has a smaller interior. Reviewer notes the AMG EQE starts at C$121,000 versus C$97,500 for the i5 M60, which rivals or beats it on almost every criterion. Original excerpt(s), from tool summaries: «too conservative»
